svg.title: A separate Dock for each desktop
svg.desc: Two cartoon Mac desktops side by side. Desktop 1 shows Safari and Notes in its Dock. Desktop 2 shows Terminal and Music. Finder and DogBar stay pinned in both. The DogBar dog walks a new, empty window over to Desktop 2.
